ow: <dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>口語感嘆詞，被撞到或痛時的聲音</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>擬聲詞（自然聲音），沒有拉丁或希臘詞根可拆</dd><dt>近義詞</dt><dd>ouch：同樣表示疼痛，使用更普遍</dd></dl>
owd: abbr. occiput-wall distance 枕部-壁距離; oil-in-water dispersions 水中油分散; ocular Whipple disease 眼惠普爾病; optical Wigner distribution 光學維格納分佈
owe:
vt. 虧欠, 負...債, 歸功於, 懷有, 應給予, 感恩
vi. 欠錢

v. be obliged to pay or repay
v. be indebted to, in an abstract or intellectual sense

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，「歸功於」義偏正式</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>古英語 agan，屬日耳曼語源，沒有拉丁或希臘詞根可拆</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>owe sb a favor；owe sb an apology；owe sth to sb；owe a debt of gratitude to</dd><dt>近義詞</dt><dd>be in debt：指處於負債的狀態，著重狀態而非欠了誰什麼</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">owe sth to sb 除了「欠某人某物」，也可表示「把…歸功於某人」，如 I owe my success to my teachers；欠款常用被動，如 the money owed to him</dd></dl>
owen:
n. Welsh industrialist and social reformer who founded cooperative communities (1771-1858)
n. English comparative anatomist and paleontologist who was an opponent of Darwinism (1804-1892)
owing:
a. 未付的, 虧欠的, 受惠的, 歸因於...的
[經] 應付的, 欠著的, 未付的

v be obliged to pay or repay
v be indebted to, in an abstract or intellectual sense

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，帳務、財務情境常見</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>bills owing；still owing on the loan</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">owing 作「未付的」多放在名詞後或 be 之後；owing to 則是另一個用法，表示「由於」</dd></dl>
owl:
n. 貓頭鷹
[法] 走私
n. nocturnal bird of prey with hawk-like beak and claws and large head with front-facing eyes
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性，日常用字</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>古英語 ule，沒有拉丁或希臘詞根可拆</dd><dt>字族</dt><dd>owlish (形容詞)</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">night owl 指習慣熬夜的人（夜貓子）</dd></dl>
owlish: a. 貓頭鷹般的, 面孔嚴肅的, 看似聰明的
s. resembling an owl; solemn and wise in appearance
own:
n. 自己的
a. 自己的, 嫡親的, 同胞的
vt. 擁有, 支配, 自認, 承認, 順從於
vi. 承認, 供認

v. have ownership or possession of
s. belonging to or on behalf of a specified person (especially yourself); preceded by a possessive

語感
中性，日常極常用；少數義項字典標為過時
詞根詞綴
古英語 agnian，源自 agen「own」，屬日耳曼語源，沒有拉丁或希臘詞根可拆
字族
owner (名詞)、ownership (名詞)、disown (動詞)、co-owner (名詞)
常見搭配
your own car；hold your own；on your own；own up to
近義詞
possess：較正式的「擁有」
have：最口語、最一般的說法
注意事項
字典說明：own 前面不能接冠詞，說 my own room，不說 an own room；own up 是「坦承」
owned: v. 擁有；承認（own的過去分詞）
a. having an owner; often used in combination
owner:
n. 擁有者, 物主, 所有人
[經] 所有者, 物主, 業主

n. (law) someone who owns (is legal possessor of) a business
n. a person who owns something

語感
中性，日常用字
詞根詞綴
own 加 -er；own 為古英語 āgen，屬日耳曼語源，沒有拉丁詞根可拆
字族
ownership (名詞)、co-owner (名詞)
常見搭配
home／pet owner；owner of；car owner；business owner
近義詞
proprietor：正式，店家或旅館的老闆
holder：持有某物或證件的人
注意事項
owner 側重擁有權，boss 才是上司，兩者不同
owner-occupied: a. 自己住的, 不出租的
s. lived in by the owner
ownership:
n. 所有權, 物主身份
[經] 所有權, 所有制

n. the relation of an owner to the thing possessed; possession with the right to transfer possession to others
n. the state or fact of being an owner
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>own ＋ 字尾 -ship（表示狀態、身分）</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>home ownership；under new ownership</dd></dl>
